name: qqnt-bridge
description: Local streaming bridge exposing the QQNT kernel to mtproto-relay

scripts.build: pnpm build:native && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs && node scripts/copy-native.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build:native && vitest run && pnpm test:native
